newsitem.title: CHINA: China seeking foreign partners in polyurethane.
newsitem.headline: China seeking foreign partners in polyurethane.

text.p: China's polyurethane sector is seeking foreign chemical companies to help meet demand from domestic automobile and electric appliance makers, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
A shortage of money for research and development combined with outdated technology was forcing Chinese polyurethane makers to seek foreign partners, Xinhua said.
Prospective investors included BASF AG and Bayer AG of Germany and Shell of the Netherlands, the agency said without elaborating.
Rampant smuggling and high imports had cut into domestic production over the last few years, the China Daily newspaper said in a separate report.
China produced 445,000 tonnes of polyurethane last year, nearly five times output in 1989, and total annual output of polyurethane products was expected to reach 700,000 tonnes by 2000, Xinhua said.
U.S.-based Dow Chemical Co and Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries Plc had already invested in polyurethane in China, it said.
